flags.title: Supplied short links do not visibly carry the tracking ID shopnow047c-20
flags.detail: The redirect target for each of the five short links has no tag= parameter. The parameters present are Amazon share-tracking values (lv, btn_type, btn_ref, channelId and similar). Commission crediting to shopnow047c-20 therefore cannot be confirmed from these URLs. The site links to the supplied short links unchanged and marks them sponsored; it does not add its own tag.
flags.action: Test one link per product in the enrolled Associates workflow and confirm destination and tracking report before scaling (see Operating Agreement Section 1 on Special Links).

flags.title: No intended ASIN was supplied; path segments are not ASIN-format
flags.detail: Each short-link path segment (for example B04G1MEwY) is 9 characters and contains lowercase letters. The observed product URLs use 10-character ASINs (for example B0CDY277D3). The intended ASIN field is therefore blank for all five products. The observed ASIN is shown separately and is not used as the intended ASIN.
flags.action: Owner to confirm the intended ASIN for each product, or confirm the observed product is the intended one.
